captions_meta.li_hook:
Five PR habits worth retiring before 2027.
A light video, a serious point.
li_body: Most of these survive because nobody questions them in the planning meeting. A quick audit:
li_points: Superlatives in headlines. Editors look for a number, a place or an impact, not "leading".
Empty quotes. If it couldn't appear in an article, cut it.
Daily follow-ups. Muck Rack (2025) found 50% of journalists say one follow-up is ideal, and 51% want it 3–7 days later.
AVE reports. AMEC's Barcelona Principles 4.0 (2025) say invalid measures such as AVEs should not be used. Report outcomes and business impact instead.
Waiting for a journalist to stumble on your social post instead of sending news to the right desk.
